title: Aligning Inductive Bias for Data-Efficient Generalization in State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.20789v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The remarkable success of modern AI has been closely tied to scaling laws, yet the finite supply of high-quality data makes data efficiency--learning more from less--an increasingly important frontier. A model's inductive bias is a critical lever for data efficiency, but foundational sequence models such as State Space Models (SSMs) often rely on fixed, task-agnostic biases. When this fixed prior is misaligned with the underlying structure of a task, the model may require additional samples to overcome its own bias before learning the relevant signal. In this work, we introduce a principled framework for understanding and aligning the inductive bias of linear time-invariant SSMs. We first formalize this bias through an SSM-induced kernel and show theoretically and empirically that its spectrum is governed by the model's frequency response. translated_title: 对齐归纳偏置以实现状态空间模型的数据高效泛化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.20789v5 公告类型：替换 摘要：现代人工智能的卓越成功与缩放定律（scaling laws）密切相关，然而高质量数据的有限供给使得数据效率——用更少的数据学到更多——成为日益重要的前沿方向。模型的归纳偏置是提升数据效率的关键杠杆，但状态空间模型（SSMs）等基础序列模型通常依赖于固定的、与任务无关的偏置。当这一固定先验与任务的底层结构不匹配时，模型可能需要额外的样本来克服自身偏置，然后才能学习相关信号。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个原则性框架，用于理解和调整线性时不变状态空间模型的归纳偏置。我们首先通过SSM诱导的核函数将该偏置形式化，并从理论和实证上证明其频谱由模型的频率响应所决定。这一表征启发了任务相关初始化，一种快速的功率谱匹配方法……
tldr: 提出任务相关初始化方法，通过对齐线性时不变状态空间模型的归纳偏置与任务底层的频谱结构，实现数据高效的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Task-Dependent Initialization (TDI) to align the inductive bias of linear time-invariant state space models with the underlying task structure via fast power-spectrum matching, enabling data-efficient generalization.
